tool_desc.read_file.zh: 读取本地文本文件。UTF-8 解码（非 UTF-8/二进制以 � 替代）；单次上限 100KB，超出仅返回前 ~100KB 并附截断提示（无 offset/行范围，截断后无法读后续，大文件请用 search_in_files 或 run_shell）。错误以「错误：」字符串返回。路径支持 ~ 展开。
tool_desc.read_file.en: Read a local text file (UTF-8; non-UTF-8/binary bytes become �). Hard cap 100KB — larger files return only the first ~100KB with a truncation notice; no offset/line-range, so for big files use search_in_files or run_shell. Errors return as strings prefixed 错误：. Paths support ~ expansion.

tool_desc.write_file.zh: 写入/创建/精确编辑本地文件。**原子写入**（临时文件+原子重命名，崩溃安全）。两模式互斥：content 全量覆写或新建（自动建父目录，≤500KB）；old_string+new_string 替换首个唯一匹配（文件须 UTF-8 且 ≤500KB）。只传 file_path 视为空内容写入，会清空原文件。路径支持绝对/相对/~ 展开。
tool_desc.write_file.en: Write/create/precisely edit a local file. **Atomic write** (temp file + atomic rename, crash-safe). Two mutually exclusive modes: content = full overwrite/create (auto-makes parent dirs, ≤500KB); old_string+new_string = replace the first unique match (file must be UTF-8, ≤500KB). Passing only file_path writes empty content, truncating the file. Paths accept absolute/relative/~.

tool_desc.run_shell.zh: 执行 shell 命令，返回退出码与输出（stdout+stderr 合并）。超时默认 30s，可用 timeout 调低（1~30s，>30 无效）。rm -rf / mkfs / dd / fdisk / chmod 777 等高危命令被硬阻止。输出 >6000 字符仅留开头，用 head/tail/grep 取其余。在应用启动目录执行，相对路径按此解析（Windows=cmd.exe，Unix=sh）。
tool_desc.run_shell.en: Execute a shell command; returns exit code and output (stdout+stderr merged). Timeout defaults to 30s (lowerable via timeout, 1-30s; >30 ignored). Destructive commands (rm -rf, mkfs, dd, fdisk, chmod 777) are hard-blocked. Output over 6000 chars is head-truncated — use head/tail/grep for the rest. Runs in the app launch directory (cmd.exe on Windows, sh on Unix).

tool_desc.search_memory.zh: 搜索记忆与会话摘要：匹配 agent 记忆文件（偏好/工作流/长期记忆）+ 会话 timeline/总览/名称，TF-IDF 相关度+时间衰减排序，固定返回前 10 条、每条 200 字摘要（非全文）。支持同义词/模糊匹配。
tool_desc.search_memory.en: Search memories & session summaries: matches agent memory files (preferences/workflows/long-term) plus session timeline/overview/name. Ranked by TF-IDF relevance with recency decay; returns fixed top-10 200-char snippets (summaries only). Synonym/fuzzy matching.

tool_desc.web.zh: 联网搜索或抓取网页转纯文本。search：DuckDuckGo，最多 10 条（默认 5），固定 15s 超时。fetch：仅 text/* 内容（HTML/纯文本；PDF/JSON 拒绝），阻断内网/本机 IP，5MB 下载/5 万字符上限（默认 3 万）；timeout、max_chars 仅 fetch 生效。失败返回描述性错误。
tool_desc.web.en: Search the web (DuckDuckGo, up to 10 results, default 5, fixed 15s) or fetch a page as plain text. fetch: text/* only (HTML/plain; PDF/JSON rejected), blocks private/internal IPs, 5MB download & 50k char caps (default 30k); timeout/max_chars apply to fetch only. Failures return descriptive errors.

tool_desc.search_in_files.zh: 正则逐行搜索文件内容（默认不区分大小写）或列目录（pattern 留空）。搜索总是递归；glob 过滤为 fnmatch 风格（不支持 {..} 花括号，例 "*.ts"/"**/*.py"）。默认跳过 >1MB 文件及忽略目录（.git/node_modules/venv/dist/build）。上限：搜索 50 条/5000 文件，列表 200 项；截断会注明。输出 路径:行号:内容。
tool_desc.search_in_files.en: Per-line regex content search (case-insensitive by default) or directory listing (empty pattern). Search is always recursive; glob filter is fnmatch style (no {..} braces; e.g. "*.ts", "**/*.py"). Skips >1MB files and ignored dirs (.git/node_modules/venv/dist/build). Limits: 50 results / 5000 files searched, 200 items listed; truncation noted. Output: path:line:content.

tool_desc.search_chat.zh: 搜索对话历史，结果只含每轮摘要（非全文）。不加 session_id 全局搜所有会话：字符二元组模糊关键词匹配（非语义）；加 session_id 限定单会话，子串+关键词匹配更精确。按相关度排序，默认 5 条、最多 20 条。
tool_desc.search_chat.en: Search chat history; returns per-turn summaries only (not full text). Without session_id: searches all sessions via character-bigram keyword matching (NOT semantic); with session_id: scopes to one session with substring+keyword matching (more precise). Sorted by relevance, default 5, max 20.

mem.reflect_system_intro.zh: 你是 Aide 的记忆反思引擎。你的任务是回顾最近的对话，同时更新三份记忆文件和会话总览。
mem.reflect_system_intro.en: You are Aide's memory reflection engine. Your task is to review recent conversations and simultaneously update three memory files and the session overview.

mem.auto_system.zh:
你是 Aide 的自动记忆提炼器。从最近一轮对话中提炼值得长期记住的偏好/工作流/长记忆，直接输出新增条目，不重写已有内容。

规则：
- 只输出 3 个 section：## Preferences / ## Workflows / ## Long-Term Memory
- 每 section 下用 "- 内容" 列出新增条目，无新增则省略该 section
- 每条不超过 40 字，宁缺毋滥，不确定的丢弃
- 与输入中已有记忆重复的不输出
- 不要输出其它任何内容
mem.auto_system.en:
You are Aide's automatic memory distiller. Extract preferences/workflows/long-term memories worth remembering from the latest conversation turn, and output only NEW entries without rewriting existing content.

Rules:
- Output only 3 sections: ## Preferences / ## Workflows / ## Long-Term Memory
- List new entries as "- content" under each section; omit sections with nothing new
- Max 40 words per entry; when in doubt, discard
- Do not repeat entries already present in the input
- Do not output anything else

mem.auto_instruction.zh: 请只输出新增条目（格式：## section + "- 内容"），不要复述已有内容。
mem.auto_instruction.en: Output only new entries (format: ## section + "- content"). Do not repeat existing content.

cmd.mem_auto.desc.zh: 自动记忆提取开关 — on/off 启用或关闭每轮静默提取新偏好/工作流/长记忆
cmd.mem_auto.desc.en: Auto memory extraction — on/off toggles silent per-turn extraction of new preferences/workflows/long-term memories

cmd.mem_auto.on.zh:
自动记忆提取已开启：每轮对话结束后静默追加新偏好/工作流/长记忆到记忆文件。
关闭用 /mem-auto off。
cmd.mem_auto.on.en:
Auto memory extraction enabled: after each turn, new preferences/workflows/long-term memories are silently appended to memory files.
Disable with /mem-auto off.

tool_desc.delegate.zh: 把子任务派给独立子 agent 跑受限工具循环，只返回压缩结论（≤4000 字符），不污染主对话。默认仅只读工具（可用 tools 覆盖）。子 agent 默认 6 轮、180s 超时；同时最多 3 个、超出拒绝。派发前先 action=status 查配额，再按 ≤3 分批派发。
tool_desc.delegate.en: Delegate a subtask to an independent sub-agent running a limited tool loop; returns a condensed conclusion (≤4000 chars), leaving the main conversation untouched. Default tools are read-only (overridable via tools). Each sub-agent: 6 turns default, 180s timeout; at most 3 run concurrently, excess rejected. Run action=status first, then batch ≤3.

tool.delegate.unavailable.zh: 错误：子 agent 运行时不可用（缺少 provider 或工具注册中心）
tool.delegate.unavailable.en: Error: sub-agent runtime unavailable (missing provider or tool registry)

tool.delegate.failed.zh: 错误：子 agent 执行失败 — {e}

tool.delegate.concurrent_limit.zh: 错误：同时运行的子 agent 已达上限（{max} 个），请稍后再试或合并子任务。
tool.delegate.concurrent_limit.en: Error: concurrent sub-agent limit reached ({max}). Retry later or merge subtasks.

tool.delegate.queue_status.zh: 子 agent 队列状态：并发上限 {max}，当前运行中 {active}，可用配额 {available}。

tool.delegate.unknown_action.zh: 错误：未知操作 '{action}'。可用：run, status

tool.delegate.subagent_system.zh:
你是 Aide 的子任务执行者。完整、彻底地完成委托给你的子任务，然后返回简洁准确的结论。

关键要求：
- 任务描述中列出的所有目标都必须处理完毕，绝不能只处理一部分就返回。
- 若任务要求读取/搜索多个文件或目录，务必全部覆盖后再给结论，不要读一个就停。
- 只有当任务范围全部覆盖时，才返回最终结论；结论保持简洁但必须完整。
tool.delegate.subagent_system.en:
You are Aide's sub-task executor. Complete the assigned subtask thoroughly, then return a concise, accurate conclusion.

Key requirements:
- Process every target listed in the task description — never return after covering only part of it.
- If the task requires reading/searching multiple files or directories, cover all of them before concluding; don't stop after one.
- Only return the final conclusion once the entire task scope is covered; keep it concise but complete.
